I am old now, 83 years, and I have been growing rice on this small piece for many seasons. I do not have money for the fertilizer from the shop — my children help me with small things but the cash is never enough, and one bag is too much money for me to risk. I will put the manure from my few goats and chickens like I always do, and I will use the seed I kept from last harvest, the same kind my mother grew. My back is not strong anymore, so my grandchildren and my daughter help me in the field, and at transplanting time I must pay one or two young people from the village to help because the work is too heavy for me alone.
